author: Praxis II
title: DAQB + Geometry Gate (τ=1.2): Tighter cross‑batch filtering by within‑batch scale
abstract: Ablation on the geometry gate strength: we set τ=1.2 so cross‑batch neighbors must be within 1.2× the within‑batch median distance for each cell. Quotas remain density‑adaptive (δ=0.15, k_density=20) with column balancing and inbound cap. Hypothesis: recover ASW_label with minimal loss of kBET/iLISI.
